v0_8_3.title: Update layout and release history
v0_8_3.summary: Fix overlapping update status and page headings. Separate version, status and actions, and add expandable release notes with offline history and new-version details.

v0_8_2.title: Automatic app updates
v0_8_2.summary: Check at startup and every four hours. Show download progress, retry failures, save state, install and reopen. Fix Windows command startup timeouts.

v0_8_0.title: New icon and collaborative maintenance
v0_8_0.summary: Unify the blue N icon. Add six-role collaboration, separate test workspaces, checkpoint recovery, project memory and resource metrics.

v0_7_0.title: Project overview and batch hosting
v0_7_0.summary: Add an interactive project graph, batch repository settings, guided setup, model lists and clearer execution and delivery states.

v0_3_0.title: Autonomous development engine
v0_3_0.summary: Introduce multi-turn plans, 34 tools, real tests, bounded repairs and independent review, with rollback and confirmed application in isolated workspaces.

v0_2_1.title: Desktop experience and ten languages
v0_2_1.summary: Refresh navigation, settings, notifications and the command palette. Add ten languages and light/dark themes; fix paused-task notifications and notification navigation.

v0_1_0.title: Windows desktop and local Agent
v0_1_0.summary: First Windows desktop preview with local AI proposals, isolated workspaces, confirmed application and task logs.

v0_8_4.title: Archived repository filtering and status
v0_8_4.summary: Hide archived repositories by default and label each row Active or Archived. Archived rows cannot be selected; select-all and counts include eligible repositories only, and sync removes newly archived selections.

v0_8_5.title: Repository reconciliation and scheduled refresh
v0_8_5.summary: Fix stale counts after repository deletion. Wait for sync completion, sync about every 60 seconds while visible, pause when hidden, share requests and respect rate-limit retries. Keep history and workspaces.

v0_8_6.title: Automatic first-use tutorial
v0_8_6.summary: The first launch opens guided setup automatically. Continue later if needed, then learn where tasks and results appear. Once completed, the tutorial stays available from the guide button without opening automatically.

v0_8_7.title: One-click dev tool install
v0_8_7.summary: The environment page gains one-click download: missing development tools are installed silently through winget, then PATH is refreshed and the environment re-scanned without an app restart.
